{{Top|leg}}
'''Dozu Lam''' was a small [[City/Legends|settlement]] and ''de facto'' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tejrivozs]]. It was established thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], originally serving as a camp for [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]] refugees. When Riflor natives began to settle down on their own planet, Dozu Lam was forgotten and abandoned.
It eventually became a haven for criminals and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="University">{{GamerCite|4|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Advozsec}}</ref>

The [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Zom Dubrotin]] was the chief administrator of Dozu Lam during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].<ref name="University" />
